title: Coinbase opens Solana DEX access as CeFi and DeFi converge
summary: Coinbase has plugged directly into Solana’s fast-growing DeFi ecosystem, letting users trade any Solana token via DEX rails without a formal listing.

title: Bubblemaps challenges PEPE’s fair launch, alleges 30% of genesis supply bundled
summary: About 30% of the initial PEPE supply was bundled under the same entity, which sold $2 million worth of tokens the day after launch, according to Bubblemaps.

title: Poland resubmits vetoed crypto bill with ‘not even a comma’ changed
summary: The Polish government reintroduced an identical version of an 84-page crypto bill that was vetoed by the president, raising questions about local versus centralized EU oversight.

title: UAE telco giant e& taps dirham stablecoin for bill payments pilot
summary: The MoU marks a cautious step toward real-world stablecoin payments in the UAE, with e& assessing how AE Coin may integrate into its digital channels.

title: XRP transaction fees drop 89%: Is price headed below $1.75?
summary: XRP price risked a 15% drop to as low as $1.73, fuelled by collapsing transaction fees, reduced speculator appetite and a weakening technical structure.

title: Norway’s central bank says CBDC ‘not warranted,’ cites strong payment system
summary: Norway rules that a digital krone is unnecessary for now, highlighting its strong payment rails and the uncertain benefits of both retail and wholesale CBDCs.

title: State Street, Galaxy and Ondo join tokenized cash race with 24/7 sweep fund
summary: State Street Investment Management and Galaxy Asset Management are launching a tokenized private liquidity fund on Solana, with Ondo expected to invest $200 million.

title: Satoshi Nakamoto statue lands on NYSE in sign of changing times
summary: There are five other Satoshi statues made by Valentina Picozzi located around the world, in Switzerland, El Salvador, Japan, Vietnam and Miami, in the US state of Florida.

title: Australian regulator eases rules for stablecoins and wrapped tokens
summary: Australia’s securities regulator has removed licensing requirements for stablecoin intermediaries and approved omnibus accounts, reducing compliance costs.

title: GOP hardliners vexed as defense bill advances without CBDC ban
summary: Conservatives in the Republican Party are frustrated that a promised ban on central bank digital currencies didn’t make it into a must-pass defense bill that’s now on its way to the Senate.
